ticket.title: archive and unarchive resolve a key from the unified index but record the event in the root store
ticket.description: Found 2026-11-10 when archiving every Verified ticket from the benchwork board: 262 archived, two did not.  GB-320 archived normally. MTR-17 could not, and the error named the wrong place:  Error: Ticket record at .gaugeblock/storypole/tickets/MTR-17.json: no record for MTR-17 and this event does not carry one  MTR-17 belongs to miter. handle_archive resolved the id from the store index - which at a suite root is the UNIFIED index, holding every member ticket - and then recorded the archive event through the root store, which holds no record for it. Every member ticket should have failed the same way; that only one did is why this looked like a UI quirk rather than a routing bug.  This is the same shape as GB-352 (reap), which is what made it recognisable: a root-scoped read of a suite-wide index followed by a root-scoped write.  FIX (storypole 29eb12b). archive and unarchive now ask which repository holds the key and, when it is not this one, open that store and record there, reporting it: "Archived task MTR-17 in miter". Refusing with an instruction would have been wrong for these two verbs specifically - a board archives in bulk and knows a key, not an owner - so they route instead.  repo_root_of moved into workspace::lookup so this handler and the reaper undo the dot-directory nesting once rather than twice.  Verified: MTR-17 archived in miter, and ledger-reconcile reports archived 264 with no verified bucket and no delta.
